description: NaFeBO₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.56-2.64 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form face-sharing FeO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.22 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form face-sharing FeO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.22 Å. B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.38 Å) and one longer (1.40 Å) B-O bond length. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two Fe, and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three equivalent Na, two Fe, and one B atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three equivalent Na, two Fe, and one B atom.
